claims.text: The artefact and its load-bearing sentence. Headline 'LA Man Joins The Jet Set - At 200 Miles An Hour', by Terry England, Monitor Staff Writer, Sunday 27 June 1982, Los Alamos Monitor, pages A1 and A8. The sentence, verbatim: 'To Lazar, a physicist at the Los Alamos Meson Physics Facility, the important thing is the jet engine.'

claims.sourceText: Los Alamos Monitor, 27 June 1982, A1 and A8, https://otherhand.org/home-page/area-51-and-other-strange-places/bluefire-main/bluefire/the-bob-lazar-corner/bobs-jetcar-article/ , opened 2026-09-18
claims.text: The Los Alamos Monitor of Sunday 27 June 1982 carried a front-page story by staff writer Terry England, 'LA Man Joins The Jet Set - At 200 Miles An Hour', pages A1 and A8, about a jet-powered Honda built by Bob Lazar, describing him in the paper's own voice as 'a physicist at the Los Alamos Meson Physics Facility'. This is the earliest dated artefact in the Lazar cluster and it predates the UFO claim by seven years.
